HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL.
Petition No. 5358 of 2001 (SS)
(Old No. 28589/1997)
Rashid Ali Khan ............ Petitioner
 Versus
District Basic Shiksha Adhikari ............ Respondents
 Dated: December 10, 2003
Hon'ble Rajesh Tandon, J.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties at length.
By the present writ petition the petitioner has prayed for the
issue of a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing
the order dated 6.8.1997.
Brief facts giving rise to the present writ petition are that the
respondent no.1 has issued a letter to the petitioner along with other
candidates to appear in the examination to be held on 10.9.1995 in
Government Girls Inter College, Rajpur Road, Dehradun. After
examination all the candidates were declared successful. Thereafter
the petitioner papered for interview before the Selection Committee
on 6.11.1995.

The grievance of the petitioner is that after selection process is
over, appointment letter was issued in his favour but his joining was
not accepted.
At the time of admission of writ petition following order was
passed:
"The version of the petitioner is that he was appointed on the
post of Assistant Teacher in Urdu. The appointment letter was issued
on 1st August 1997 (Annexure-5 to the writ petition). He was not
permitted to join the institution. He filed writ petition no.5882 of
1997. The Court directed the Zila Basic Shisha Adhikari, Dehradun to
decide the representation. The representation has been decided by the
impugned order dated 14.5.1997. The order indicates that there is ban
in the appointment and secondly that there is no vacant post of
Assistant Teacher in the Institution.
The contention of learned counsel for the petitioner is that the
post of Assistant Teacher in Urdu is still vacant. In case the post of
Assistant Teacher in Urdu is vacant in any Institution within the
District of Dehradun, the petitioner can be considered for
appointment."
In view of the aforesaid order, the respondents are directed to
consider the candidature of the petitioner for the post of Assistant

Teacher in Urdu in if the post is still lying vacant within the District of
Dehradun.
The writ petition is disposed of in terms of the order dated
5.9.1997. No order as to costs.
10.12.2003 (Rajesh Tandon, J.)
Dhyani
